name: Silver Sachet With Grape, Flower and Bird Patterns
description: The silver sachet with grape, flower and bird patterns is a cultural relic of the Tang Dynasty. It is carved with hollow patterns throughout, with grapes entwining branches and flowers and birds depending on each other. It is gorgeous and exquisite. It is a representative of the aesthetics and "black technology" of the Tang Dynasty. It is also a token of love between Concubine Yang Guifei and Emperor Xuanzong of the Tang Dynasty. It has unique historical significance. Pinku joins forces with Wu Xitang to deconstruct palace aesthetics, integrate ancient and modern Chinese and Western styles, and inherit cultural relics and treasures through 3D metal puzzles. The inner layer of the product restores the shape of the national treasure, and the outer layer is a newly created hanging decoration, with flowers like brocade and cranes soaring in the clouds, which is bright and moving.
